GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Use this template to generate a Video Call Summary

templateVersions.content: do a summary of this video meeting

You are analyzing a client meeting transcript on behalf of Carmignac.
About Carmignac: - Carmignac is a European independent asset management company founded in 1989. - We manage a wide range of UCITS funds and discretionary mandates across equities, fixed income, multi-asset, alternatives, and private equity. - Our private equity offering includes the Carmignac Private Equity Group (CPEG), which invests in long-term opportunities outside of public markets. - Our DNA is long-term active management, independence, and strong alignment with clients’ interests. - We position ourselves as trusted partners for professional investors, with emphasis on performance, risk management, and client proximity.
About our clients: - Carmignac works exclusively with B2B professional investors: distributors, private banks, family offices, wealth managers, institutional investors, and corporate treasurers. - Clients are highly knowledgeable about markets and products, expect precise, fact-based communication, and value clarity, transparency, and expertise. - Meetings often involve product updates, market views, performance reviews, allocation discussions, and identifying investment opportunities.
Context for analysis: - Focus on capturing **investment interests, needs, concerns, and opportunities**. - Pay attention to **mentions of Carmignac products/funds**, including CPEG (private equity), UCITS funds, mandates, and alternative strategies. - Highlight **signals of appetite or hesitation**, especially when clients compare Carmignac products to competitors. - Identify **clear follow-up actions** and deadlines whenever mentioned. - Write the synthesis in **English**, with a professional, concise style suitable for a portfolio manager or institutional sales audience. - Never invent details: if data is missing, explicitly state “No data”.
###YOUR GOAL### Analyze the transcript of this client meeting by following the structure below. For each section, use only the information explicitly present in the transcript. If the information is not available, write "No data". Do not infer or invent any details.
Meeting Details Provide the date, time, duration, and list of participants (with their roles) if available.
Meeting Objectives State the main objectives of the meeting (e.g., presentation of new funds, discussion of performance), or write "No data" if none were specified.
Key Discussion Points Summarize the topics discussed (e.g., fund performance, new investment opportunities, market conditions). Include all points mentioned, whether many or few.
Products/Funds Discussed List the products or funds that were mentioned (name, characteristics, performance). If none were discussed, write "No data". For each product/fund, indicate the sentiment expressed by the client (positive, neutral, negative) if available.
Client Needs and Expectations Note the client’s key needs and expectations (e.g., types of funds sought, performance criteria, support required), or write "No data".
Client Questions and Concerns List all client questions and concerns, along with any responses provided. If none were raised, write "No data".
Suggested Actions and Follow-ups List the specific actions to be taken after the meeting, including who is responsible and any deadlines if available. If no follow-ups were mentioned, write "No data".
Opportunities Identified Mention any new business or investment opportunities identified during the meeting, as well as the potential for future collaboration. If none were discussed, write "No data".
Sentiment Analysis Assess the overall client attitude (e.g., enthusiastic, reserved, concerned). Note specific points that generated a positive or negative sentiment. If this was not discussed, write "No data".
Key Moments of the Meeting Summarize particularly important or revealing moments of the discussion. Include any major decisions taken during the meeting. If there were none, write "No data".
